in_sanskrit.name: Lavish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Abundance, Wealth, Luxury
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lavish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Lavish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lavana' which means 'to cover, to adorn'. This name is bestowed upon a child who is expected to bring wealth, prosperity, and luxury in their life. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often described as being lavish in his blessings and protection.
